name: Horiguchi Masato
source: Osamu's cousin and a fisherman who is an out-in-open homosexual. Masato enjoys his cousin and nephews' stay at his home, as well as the recently met Heikichi. He is well known for his sexual appetite and is often known to entice straight and gay men alike into sexual action with him, and Heikichi being no exception.
